about_blocks.text: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres: Treating Addictions and Co-Occurring Disorders
about_blocks.html: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres: Treating Addictions and Co-Occurring Disorders

about_blocks.text: At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they take a comprehensive approach to treating substance and process addiction, mental health conditions, and co-occurring disorders. Their experienced masters-level therapists lead both group and individual therapy sessions, tailored to each client’s unique needs. Clients receive three individual therapy sessions per week, along with a variety of group therapy sessions and workshops.
about_blocks.html: At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they take a comprehensive approach to treating substance and process addiction, mental health conditions, and co-occurring disorders. Their experienced masters-level therapists lead both group and individual therapy sessions, tailored to each client’s unique needs. Clients receive three individual therapy sessions per week, along with a variety of group therapy sessions and workshops.

about_blocks.text: They offer residential treatment programs ranging from 30 to 90 days, along with an intensive outpatient program (IOP) and a virtual rehab program. Before beginning treatment, clients receive a psychiatric assessment to determine the best program for their specific needs. During treatment, they have access to addiction counsellors 24/7, along with a range of wellness options to support their recovery journey.

about_blocks.text: Group and Family Programs: Supporting Addiction Recovery
about_blocks.html: Group and Family Programs: Supporting Addiction Recovery

about_blocks.text: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understands that addiction recovery is not just an individual journey, but one that impacts loved ones as well. They offer specialized group and family programs to support clients and their families throughout the recovery process.
about_blocks.html: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understands that addiction recovery is not just an individual journey, but one that impacts loved ones as well. They offer specialized group and family programs to support clients and their families throughout the recovery process.

about_blocks.text: Their weekly group therapy sessions include psychoeducational skill groups, skill-based workshops, gender-specific groups, and PTSD groups for first responders. They also provide individual therapy sessions with experienced therapists who use evidence-based practices such as EMDR, CBT, and DBT. A pain management group is available for clients dealing with chronic pain, while on-site support groups for friends and family meet regularly.

about_blocks.text: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres- Center Overview
about_blocks.html: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres- Center Overview

about_blocks.text: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is a premier private rehab center that specializes in providing unparalleled care to individuals struggling with mental health, drug and alcohol abuse. Located in beautiful Erin, Ontario, the center offers a wide range of treatment programs and therapies that cater to the unique needs of each client.
about_blocks.html: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is a premier private rehab center that specializes in providing unparalleled care to individuals struggling with mental health, drug and alcohol abuse. Located in beautiful Erin, Ontario, the center offers a wide range of treatment programs and therapies that cater to the unique needs of each client.

about_blocks.text: The rehab center boasts of a fully equipped facility that offers 12-step programs, outpatient drug rehab, as well as individual, group, and family therapy and counseling. Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres also believes in treating the whole person, and therefore offers holistic therapies such as yoga and meditation, art and nature therapy, and nutritional counseling. All these services are aimed at promoting overall wellness and providing clients with the support they need to overcome addiction and achieve long-term recovery.
